title: 第25章 共鸣
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
炼丹室在后山脚下，一排凿在岩壁上的石窟。

    沈霜让守门弟子带他们到了最深处的石窟。

    洞里配着一口地火炼丹炉，炉壁上嵌了三面观火镜。

    比徐老头摊子上那口补丁青铜炉气派得多。

    “紫鳞解毒丹的丹方。”沈霜把那张泛黄的丹方放在桌上，“清心草五株，银叶花三朵，紫鳞果核一枚。火候全程控制在五成炉火，任何波动都会让紫鳞果核的灵纹逆向分解。你们有三份药材，三次机会。炼成了，紫鳞果归你们。炼不成，按市价买。还有什么问题？”

    “入炉顺序不对。”林尘盯着丹方看了片刻。

    “丹方上写的是先入清心草，后入紫鳞果核。但清心草是木属性，紫鳞果核是火属性，木生火——先入清心草会让木属性在炉内先铺开，紫鳞果核入炉后火属性毒性被木属性助长，融合时毒性峰值会比顺序颠倒高出至少三成。”

    沈霜沉默了一会儿，把丹方翻过来，在背面重新写了一行字：先入紫鳞果核，后入清心草，银叶花置中缓冲。

    “这个顺序是落雁谷内部的炼制流程，丹方上没写。能一眼看出入炉顺序对毒性峰值的影响——你的灵纹感知能力确实超出了普通炼丹师的范畴。苍梧宗掌门在信里没提你会炼丹，看来这封信是在你们离开之后写的。”

    “炼丹是最近几天刚学的。之前的基础为零。”

    “几天之内能从零基础到看穿紫鳞解毒丹的入炉顺序——你的体质应该是混沌圣体。”沈霜放下笔。

    “掌门在信里没写这一点，但我猜到了。落雁谷的藏书阁里有关于上古十大圣体的残卷记载，混沌圣体排在首位。不过不管你是什么体质，在落雁谷就要守落雁谷的规矩。第一，不许在药田里练功。第二，不许采摘未成熟的药材。第三，不许半夜在后山乱跑。后山有一只金丹巅峰的铁背犀，盘踞在紫鳞果生长区外围，上个月有个筑基期的散修半夜溜进去，第二天早上我们只找到了他的一只鞋。”

    “紫鳞果成熟还需要多久？”

    “最快的一枚还要五天。这五天你们可以住在谷里，药材园和藏书阁对你们开放。五天之后紫鳞果成熟，你们自己想办法从铁背犀的领地边缘把果实摘下来——谷里人手不足，无法派人协助。铁背犀的弱点是转身速度慢，但皮糙肉厚，元婴初期一剑只能留痕。别想着硬拼，动脑子。”

    沈霜推门出去了，脚步声渐渐消失在走廊尽头。

    苏荇把补丁青铜炉从马背上卸下来放在地火口上，又从背包里翻出两个备用的学徒炉摆在旁边。

    “三份药材，三次机会。紫鳞解毒丹是玄阶上品，我是玄阶下品丹师，正常成功率不到一成。不过加上你的灵纹感知，一加一未必只等于二。”

    “你来配药，我控火。”林尘把青铜炉翻过来，手指蘸着清心草汁在炉底画御灵符阵。

    最后一笔落下时混沌灵力顺着药汁渗入符阵纹路，整个符阵亮起淡金色的微光。

    他没有开地火——符阵自行转化的灵火温度比地火稳定得多。

    苏荇把第一份药材按配比放进炉内，盖上炉盖。

    观火镜里，紫鳞果核的十二道鳞片灵纹在灵火中缓缓展开，清心草的木属性灵纹紧随其后进入融合区。

    木生火，火属性毒性在木属性助长下急速攀升。

    银叶花的水属性缓冲层在第三息时被压出裂纹。

    “银叶花不够。水属性被木火双重夹击，缓冲层厚度需要增加五成。”林尘盯着观火镜。
content_en:
The alchemy room is at the foot of the back mountain, in a row of grottoes carved into the rock wall.

    Shen Shuang asked the gatekeeper to take them to the deepest cave.

    The cave is equipped with an earth-fire alchemy furnace, and three fire-viewing mirrors are embedded in the furnace wall.

    It's much more elegant than the patchwork bronze furnace in Old Man Xu's stall.

    "The recipe for Purple Scale Detoxification Pill." Shen Shuang put the yellowed prescription on the table, "Five plants of Qingxincao, three Silver Leaf Flowers, and one Purple Scale Fruit Core. The heat is controlled at 50% throughout the whole process. Any fluctuation will cause the spiritual patterns of the Purple Scale Core to reversely decompose. You have three medicinal materials and three chances. Once it is refined, the Purple Scale Fruit is yours. If it cannot be refined, buy it at the market price. Any questions?"

    "The order of entering the furnace is wrong." Lin Chen stared at the pill recipe for a moment.

    "The prescription states that the pure heart grass should be put in first, and then the purple scale core. But the pure heart grass has a wood attribute, and the purple scale core has a fire attribute. Wood generates fire - adding the pure heart grass first will cause the wood attribute to spread in the furnace first. After the purple scale core is put into the furnace, the fire attribute toxicity is fueled by the wood attribute. The peak toxicity during fusion will be at least 30% higher than if the order was reversed."

    Shen Shuang was silent for a while, then turned the elixir over and wrote a new line on the back: first put in the purple scale fruit core, then put in the pure grass, and put the silver leaf flower in the middle for buffer.

    "This sequence is the internal refining process of Luoyan Valley. It is not written on the elixir recipe. You can see at a glance the impact of the order of entering the furnace on the peak toxicity - your ability to perceive spiritual patterns is indeed beyond the scope of ordinary alchemists. The head of Cangwu Sect did not mention in the letter that you can refine alchemy. It seems that this letter was written after you left."

    "I just learned alchemy in the past few days. My previous foundation was zero."

    "In a few days, you can go from scratch to see through the order of the Purple Scale Detoxification Pill - your constitution should be the Chaos Holy Body." Shen Shuang put down the pen.

    "The leader didn't write this in the letter, but I guessed it. There are fragments of records about the ten ancient holy bodies in Luoyan Valley, and the Chaos Holy Body ranks first. But no matter what your physique is, you must abide by the rules of Luoyan Valley in Luoyan Valley. First, you are not allowed to practice in the medicine field. Second, you are not allowed to pick immature medicinal materials. Third, you are not allowed to run around in the back mountain in the middle of the night. There is a golden elixir peak iron-backed rhinoceros in the back mountain, entrenched in the periphery of the purple scale fruit growing area. Last month, a casual cultivator in the foundation period sneaked in, and the next morning we only found one of his shoes. "

    "How long will it take for the purple scale fruit to mature?"

    "The fastest one will take five days. During these five days, you can live in the valley, and the medicinal garden and library are open to you. After five days, the purple-scaled fruit will mature, and you can find a way to pick the fruits from the edge of the Iron-backed Rhinoceros' territory - there are not enough manpower in the valley to send people to assist. The Iron-backed Rhinoceros's weakness is that it is slow to turn, but its skin is rough and thick, and a sword in the early stage of Nascent Soul can only leave a mark. Don't think about fighting head-on, use your brain."

    Shen Shuang opened the door and went out, and the sound of footsteps gradually disappeared at the end of the corridor.

    Su Yun unloaded the patched bronze furnace from his horse and placed it on the ground fire. He also took out two spare apprentice furnaces from his backpack and placed them next to them.

    "Three medicinal materials, three opportunities. The Purple Scale Antidote Pill is a high-grade Xuan-level alchemy master. I am a low-grade Xuan-level alchemy master. The normal success rate is less than 10%. But with your spiritual pattern perception, one plus one may not only equal two."

    "You prepare the medicine, and I'll control the fire." Lin Chen turned the bronze furnace over, dipped his fingers in the juice of Qingxin grass and drew a spirit-protecting talisman array on the bottom of the furnace.

    When the last stroke fell, the spiritual power of chaos penetrated into the lines of the talisman array along with the concoction, and the entire talisman array lit up with a faint golden light.

    He did not turn on the earth fire - the temperature of the spiritual fire transformed by the talisman array is much more stable than that of the earth fire.

    Su Yun put the first batch of medicinal materials into the furnace according to the proportion and closed the furnace lid.

    In the fire viewing mirror, the twelve scale spiritual patterns of the purple scale fruit core slowly unfolded in the spiritual fire, and the wood attribute spiritual patterns of Qingxincao followed closely into the fusion zone.

    Wood creates fire, and the toxicity of the fire attribute increases rapidly with the help of the wood attribute.

    The water attribute buffer layer of Silver Leaf Flower was cracked during the third breath.

    "The Silver Leaf Flower is not enough. The water attribute is double attacked by wood and fire, so the thickness of the buffer layer needs to be increased by 50%." Lin Chen stared at the fire viewing mirror.
